plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the -54.14% loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Review this new, leveraged ETF. Its -56.5% loss is significant and amplified by margin.
SMH: Respect the 540 stop. If it breaks, trim as indicated by your scanner.
